mentions.name: Cobol Copilot
mentions.description: This tool combines static analysis and programming language theory with large language models to help large enterprises decode and understand their legacy COBOL systems.
mentions.problem: Legacy COBOL systems are difficult for large enterprises to decode and understand.
mentions.audience: Large enterprises with legacy COBOL systems
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://www.cobolcopilot.com/

We use a combination of 1) static analysis/PL theory and 2) Large Language Models to help large enterprises decode their legacy COBOL systems
